name: rocking frog stretch
description: A rocking frog stretch that opens the hips and inner thighs. Helps loosen the glutes and groin.
instructions: Start on all fours, then slide your knees apart to a comfortable width with your lower legs pointing out to the sides.
Lower onto your forearms and keep your hips roughly in line with your knees.
Slowly rock your hips backward until you feel a gentle stretch along the inner thighs.
Rock forward to ease the stretch, then repeat without forcing the range.
